shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "pwd && rg --files -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!package-lock.json'"' -g '"'!yarn.lock'"' -g '"'!pnpm-lock.yaml'"' -g '"'!*lock*'"' -g 'AGENTS.md' -g 'package.json' -g 'src/**' -g 'app/**' -g 'pages/**' -g '.agents/skills/gravity-ui/**' -g 'index.html' -g '*config*'"
/bin/bash -lc 'cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md'

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,100p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && rg -n -C 3 '@gravity-ui/charts|@gravity-ui/chartkit' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && cat package.json src/App.tsx src/main.tsx && cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md"

/bin/bash -lc "ls -a && sed -n '148,166p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Button Text SegmentedRadioGroup Select ThemeProvider && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm install @gravity-ui/charts'

/bin/bash -lc "bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Button Text SegmentedRadioGroup Select ThemeProvider && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md && rg -n -C 3 'useTheme|useThemeType|base-background|base-float' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/theming.md"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm install @gravity-ui/charts@1'

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/package.json && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/README.md && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroup.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/ThemeProvider.d.ts && rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts | rg '(INDEX.md|types.*d.ts|Chart.d.ts|Line.*d.ts|Axis.*d.ts)'"

/bin/bash -lc "rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.d.ts && sed -n '1,120p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/theming.md"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs/INDEX.md && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/useThemeSettings.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/useThemeType.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/line.d.ts && sed -n '1,160p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/axis.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs/guides/theming.md node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs/guides/colors.md && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/ThemeSettingsContext.d.ts && rg -n -C 2 'tickInterval|grid|tickAmount' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/axis.d.ts && cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/icons.md && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/chart.d.ts | head -100"

/bin/bash -lc "npm install @gravity-ui/icons@2 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/README.md | head -65 && rg 'export.*(ArrowDownToLine|ArrowUpRight|Sun|Moon|Calendar|ChartLine|CircleInfo|ChevronDown|Check)' node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/dist/index.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/useTheme.d.ts && sed -n '175,270p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/axis.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/marker.d.ts | head -90 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/components/Chart/Chart.d.ts && rg -o -- '--g-color-(text-positive|text-utility|base-positive-light|base-float|infographics-[a-z-]+)' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css | sort -u | head -35"

/bin/bash -lc "rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons | rg '(index.d.ts|package.json)"'$'"' && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/useTheme.d.ts && sed -n '175,270p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/axis.d.ts && head -85 node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/marker.d.ts && rg -n 'ChartData|ChartProps' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/index.d.ts && rg -o -- '--g-color-(text-positive|text-utility|base-positive-light|base-float|infographics-[a-z-]+)' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css | sort -u | head -35"

/bin/bash -lc "rg 'export.*(ArrowDownToLine|ArrowUpRight|Sun|Moon|Calendar|ChartLine|CircleInfo|ChevronDown|Check|ArrowRight|Persons)' node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/index.d.ts && rg -o -- '--g-color-(text-positive|text-utility|base-positive-light|base-float|infographics-[a-z-]+)' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css | sort -u | head -35 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/index.d.ts | head -50 && rg -n -C 2 'var\\(|getComputedStyle' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/utils/color* && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/tooltip.d.ts | head -95"

/bin/bash -lc 'cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/tooltip.d.ts | head -80 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Select/types.d.ts | head -100 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/base.d.ts | head -75 && cat tsconfig.json && cat index.html'

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n 'resolve.*[Cc]olor|parse.*[Cc]olor|color\\(' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/utils/color* node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/shapes/line/prepare* && git diff --stat"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/utils/color.js && rg -n -C 2 'color|stroke' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/shapes/line/prepare-shape.js && git status --short && cat .gitignore"

/bin/bash -lc "git status --short && rg -n 'stroke:|color:' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/shapes/line/*.js | head -20 && npm run build > /tmp/pulse-build.log 2>&1 && tail -n 8 /tmp/pulse-build.log"
